# Source-backed test design

The minimum sufficient set falsifies every active in-scope obligation. Requirements/authorized confirmations define expected behavior; code defines As-Is paths and observation seams. A generated AC, historical case or public best practice cannot promote a proposal to Confirmed.

## Selected topic basis

Standalone research stays compact in `scope-and-approach` unless extra Research is explicitly requested. Invoked mode consumes exactly the shared ResearchHandoff's eight fields and checks only selected actual topic files, captured byte identities, consumed questions/clauses and decisive source/code/confirmation dependencies. No whole-folder digest or required load of unrelated topics. Relevant drift or wrong conclusions produces scoped research/delta here and keeps affected work Draft; unrelated topic additions/edits do not invalidate the basis. Frozen inputs are immutable. Read legacy flat `research@1.0.0` with its original schema/baseline without rewriting or repinning; newly requested topics follow registry `research@1.1.0`, verified feature-root destination and meaningful basename/verified-ID rules.

## Obligation and regression boundaries

For each source clause identify actor, operation, conditions/settings, input/state, outcome, exceptions and preserved state. Trace the actual entry/handler through authorization, settings, persistence/readback and consumers. Map materially distinct branches to case/variant or gap in scope-and-approach. Reverse-map every expected to its source.

Enumerate a finite set completely at the boundary owning membership/order. Downstream representative values need evidence of equivalent handler/storage/oracle. Distinct writers, permission paths, state transitions and output formats can fail independently; do not reduce them merely to shorten the document. A source enumeration does not imply a Cartesian product over every screen/actor. Record the reduction rationale and expand on refresh if the diff adds distinct branches.

Regression requires a source-preservation obligation, affected shared dependency/diff, or applicable canonical rule. Same folder/page family alone is insufficient. Conditional regression names a known expected plus exact future diff trigger; already proven affected paths are required now. Known legacy defects remain explicit; do not silently waive them or blame the new feature.

## Scenario grouping

One TC has one clear objective; not one TC per label, click, persistence field or screenshot. A related UI label/selection/readback assertion belongs at a checkpoint in the scenario that exercises it. Group compatible fixture, actor, trigger, source/writer, oracle and reset families into explicit variants. Separate scenarios when grouping hides an independently failing permission, lifecycle, source, writer, transaction or output format, or requires unrelated preparation. No numerical case quota is a coverage gate.

Before removing an independent case during an authorized refresh, map each old Case/Variant, source obligation and branch to a new Case/Variant/Checkpoint or gap in scope Coverage. Put `old <ID>:<variant> → <new identity>; disposition; reason` in Rationale / proof limit; keep references in the target column machine-resolvable. Retain all negative controls and preservation checks. A concise document with fewer assertions is not equivalent coverage. Do not transfer historical PASS or evidence when expected, fixture/state or trigger changes.

Each new variant owns inputs, numbered action delta and a concrete final Expected; meaningful checkpoints retain temporal/preservation proof. Shared actions/setup are written once; every variant can reconstruct/reset its fixture independently. Never make `cancel` inherit the `confirm` outcome or `<` inherit `≤` outcomes. Distinguish an incomplete rule from a stale form saved after deletion; the latter has a separate writer/lifecycle assertion. An AND family needs all-positive and one negative for each predicate, not only a generic negative.

## Discriminating preparation and observations

Work backward from expected: which action causes it, which fixture establishes the condition, and which observation rejects the plausible defect? Reopening after save and checking non-target data catches persistence/scope errors. For an AND predicate use all-eligible positive and single-predicate-negative controls. For a restriction, attempt the forbidden operation and observe refusal plus preservation; UI disabled alone does not prove server non-mutation. Use a verified request seam rather than inventing URL/method/payload/status.

Use distinguishable initial/replacement and target/non-target values. Rebuild cleared child data before each independently tested transition. Outputs name actual artifact/filter/school/year/role and expected rows/values. Prefer supported setup/reset; unverified DB/API assistance is a preparation gap, never an executed fact. A fixture reference resolves to this revision's create/verify/reset instructions. Case-local data stays in the case.

## Gaps, state and modes

Discoverable facts need source/code investigation or smallest missing check; engineering alternatives remain valid when equivalent; business decisions retain known obligations and stable question/gap IDs; preparation/proof gaps retain known expected. Unknown oracle stays gap/Draft, not runnable PASS/N/A. Missing fixture or unverified entry/observation cannot be Ready. Proposed expectations are labelled, never business approval.

`design` may retain unresolved seams as Draft; `finalize` verifies concrete setup/ordered action/observation/evidence without claiming execution; `refresh` edits affected meaning only and preserves stable IDs/variants/history. Proof types (static/UI/API/DB/integration/export/device) establish different boundaries: source/schema/query text is not live DB/API/UI proof. New designs have no per-case actual-result sections in Markdown.

Record one `Execution lane` per case and justified seams/limits in scope: Browser, Integration, DB, Security or Performance. Keep missing non-browser fixtures as gaps rather than dropping obligations. Evidence checkpoints identify stage (`setup`, `before`, `result`, `after`, `export`), concrete assertion, precise focus and artifact (`screenshot`, `export`, `inspection`). Screenshots default to sufficient viewport capture (full_page=false), with full page only for necessary whole-layout proof, reviewed minimal non-overlapping highlights and meaningful top-right English observed note; plan enough views for the assertion, not an arbitrary one-image quota. Configuration proves configuration only. Actual Excel/PDF exports need the application file and content verification; browser screenshots are supplementary. Note truth, expected authority, preparation readiness and execution status remain independent.

## Export interface

The exporter accepts the **fixed template Markdown schema** rather than guessing arbitrary prose. It reads the requested-language trio and checks supplied counterparts for identity parity. It does not judge business correctness or translate. Current authored cases use `test-cases@1.3.0` with scope/data `1.0.0`, projecting only `test-report@2.4.0`. Supported source1.0..1.2 inputs keep their original grammar/oracles under the parser; they require no old workbook or template asset. New output headings/provenance/labels match the current assets. Table cells use `<br>` for line breaks and `&#124;` for a literal pipe; raw/escaped pipes and multiline rows are rejected rather than silently split. No fenced case rows, nested tables or compound `a/b/c` variant shorthand.

- Each source has exactly one `Revision` field with the same value; the scope's `Nguồn` pins authorized source identities. This is a design revision, not a source of approval.
- `### Context: CTX-ID` under conventions contains a field/value table. A case value `@CTX-ID` inherits **that same field only**; mixed reference/prose is invalid. Local values override explicitly. No recursive context references.
- `### Flow: <business group>` and `#### TC-ID — title` delimit ordered cases. Current conventions require `Revision`, `Feature`, `Feature ID`, `Conventions`; use the verified feature ID, not title/slug. Cases add `Execution lane` after Priority. Action is `@Steps`; case Expected is concrete overall outcome prose. Steps, Variants and Checkpoints are mandatory in that order. Steps use exactly `Step | Action` with consecutive positive numbers. Variants use `Variant | Inputs | Action delta | Expected`; always list `base` for a single run with concrete final Expected for that branch. Action delta is exactly `none`, or concrete changes that name an existing step with `Step N` / `step N`, `Bước N` / `bước N`, or `ステップ N` (`N` is its positive integer). For example, `Step 2: cancel deletion` changes shared step 2. Bare numeric labels such as `2:` or `3:` are invalid. Keep one Reset field, not a duplicated Reset step. Reject unresolved/branch-referencing outcomes; semantic source review still checks their correctness.
- Checkpoints use `Variant | Checkpoint | Step | Stage | Expected | Focus | Artifact`. Each variant has concrete nonempty Expected rows referencing an existing step. Checkpoint IDs are unique case-insensitively within a variant, stages/artifacts use the enums above, and Focus names the exact value/area/controls needed to prove the assertion. No unresolved placeholders, `@Steps`/`@Checkpoints` or another branch's expected in the concrete oracle. The case Reset rebuilds state independently. Checkpoints are meaningful required capture/inspection/export milestones, not a per-click or two-image quota. These fields implement [TestRunIdentity](../_kit/shared/automation-testing.md#common-identity-and-report-binding), not a separate execution dataset. Frozen 1.2.0 retains four-column Steps and case/variant @Checkpoints; older compact/expanded/optional-variant grammar remains version-dispatched.
- `Fixture` references are exact IDs separated by `, `; `local: ...` denotes reproducible case-local setup, not a fabricated shared fixture. `Bảo toàn`, `Bằng chứng`, `Reset` cannot be empty; genuine inapplicability states a reason. Ready has exactly `Gap=none`. Draft/Blocked has one or more existing gap IDs, separated by comma and one space: `G-X` or `G-X, G-Y`. Preserve independent blockers; do not invent an aggregate gap to hide them. Duplicate/undefined IDs, semicolons, `none` mixed with IDs and annotations/prose in the reference field are rejected.
- Shared fixtures use `### Fixture: TD-ID` and the fixed field/value table. Even an empty fixture set retains the Fixtures heading and an explicit no-shared-fixtures statement. Coverage reference cells contain only existing `TC-ID`, `TC-ID:variant`, `TC-ID:variant:checkpoint` (1.2.0/1.3.0) or `G-ID`, separated by comma and one space. No duplicate references, semicolons, step annotations or prose; put old-ID mapping, execution lane, reduction rationale and proof limits in Rationale / proof limit. Each gap row has exactly one Kind from `business`, `fact`, `engineering`, `preparation`, `proof`; secondary limitations go in Missing decision / proof, distinct independent causes retain separate gap IDs. Grammar examples are not invented source IDs. Metadata/context/fixture/step/variant/checkpoint records are projected without a parallel persisted source.
- Each case/variant has one editable result row in the same report. Scope, expected basis/readiness and execution remain independent. One workbook contains one run; preserve it and use a new requested path for another run/revision. Do not copy old observations onto changed expected or append partial result blocks.

Generator CLI: `--source-dir PATH --output NEW.xlsx [--language vi]`. The exact bundled asset, canonical layouts and entry/check lifecycle are described in [report guidance](test-report.md). Unsupported language, malformed source/schema, unresolved references, mismatched revision, too-long Excel text and existing output fail without replacing a file. Literal text is preserved; formula-like observations never become executable formulas. Long essential content stays readable in the same Testcases block rather than being dropped or shrunk. All variant Actual/Status and checkpoint-owned images are within that block; exactly two sheets, never a third Evidence sheet.

Summary formulas and the checker count cases and scenarios separately using the same [recorded-input contract](test-report.md#recorded-counts-and-case-outcomes). Eligible recorded PASS/FAIL require Confirmed + Ready and nonblank trimmed actual; image binding, genuine review and access verification are separate. Recorded-judgment coverage divides eligible recorded PASS + FAIL by all scenarios; pass rate divides eligible recorded PASS by those recorded judgments. Zero denominators display no data. Every required scenario must qualify as recorded PASS for case PASS; all-SKIPPED cases stay SKIPPED, while mixed PASS/SKIPPED and other incomplete mixtures have a derived incomplete result. This adds no dropdown state. Case/variant/checkpoint and projected/group identity collisions under case-insensitive matching are rejected, not rewritten. SKIPPED needs reason and BLOCKED needs blocker; proposed observations never become confirmed requirement proof. Read-only checking reports gaps; it neither repairs inputs nor generates another report. Formula text and export success are structural evidence only; actual recalculation/rendering and human/source review remain distinct checks.
